title: Effective anode materials for in situ Sn@C nano-lamellar assembly with doped nanotubes in lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19176-19191
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02378E, Paper
Open Access

Mengna Xie, Yongheng Zhou, Shuai Dong, Fei Li, Fenghua Zhang, Wei Wei, Jinhai Cui
A unique nano-lamellar structure, combined with diffusion-controlled and capacity-controlled lithium-ion dynamics, achieves remarkable electrochemical performance for this kind of Sn-based anode material in lithium-ion batteries.
